en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly landscape. In the left foreground stands a tall historic church tower dominating clustered traditional houses with steep roofs. To the right, on a slight elevation, are larger fortified-looking buildings including a round tower and other castle-like structures. Fields and gardens lie in the foreground. At the top left, printed text reads "Zschopau i. Sa.", indicating the town name.
